comments.body:
APPROVED design (from cranial-goodly-seahog escaped-bug deep-dive; user-approved 2026-08-18). Two grounded false-negatives drove this:

CITRIC-PREREGAL-LADYBIRD (impact undercount): matched finding [regression, deletion-impact, tests] scored validity=1.0, impact=0.30, priority=0.30 — below deletion-impact@0.60 / api-compat@0.51. Removed PUBLIC API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was labeled capability_degraded+reachable_path_without_automated_coverage (MODERATE 0.6) not unversioned_published_contract_break (SERIOUS 0.9); trigger_likelihood=rare (prod x0.25); churn90=0 (maint freq_mult x0.5). Reproduced exactly: correcting ANY one -> impact 0.60 (clears both).

BRATTISH-LADYISH-JAGUAR (validity drop + zero impact): [regression, edge-cases] finding at _build-and-test.yml:123 dropped at validity 0.4286 (<0.5), evidence_entails_finding=no + several insufficient; every consequence binary false -> impact 0.0. Pure pass-2 recall failure on a workflow-YAML artifact.

APPROVED CHANGES:
(a1) freq_mult reshape — churn AMPLIFY-ONLY, never suppress. Reshape freq_mult from [0.5..1.0] to [1.0..1.x] so a hot file boosts a maintainability finding but a cold/NEW file (churn90=0 includes every brand-new file) never discounts it below its intrinsic tier. AND never let the frequency multiplier reduce a SERIOUS-tier binary. This subsumes the contract-break case and kills the general new/quiet-file FN class without per-criterion exceptions (see decide.impact_code freq_mult, workflow_ops._churn_90d = git log --since=90d count).
(a2) version-signal gating — classify unversioned_published_contract_break SERIOUS only when the removal LACKS a version/deprecation signal (major bump / deprecation cycle / CHANGELOG breaking-change). Managed removals do not trip; unmanaged ones flag (correct: client usage is unobservable). Resolution paths: add version/deprecation; scope-intent context (note code-review has NO auto on-target veto); fp_ledger fp:code-review NO-FIRE case.
(proposal-3, approved earlier) pass-2 removed-public-symbol sub-question — key detection on the EXPORT (name reachable from the public API: __all__/re-export, CLI command, MCP tool), NOT on a cited caller. Absence of an internal caller does not prove an external API unused.
Pass-3 validity<0.5 hard-drop stays impact-blind (making it impact-aware resurrects noise and would not have saved brattish — impact was 0.0); the lever is pass-2 recall/labeling, not the floor.

compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
Two grounded code-review false negatives (escaped-bug deep-dive on cranial-goodly-seahog; user-approved design 2026-08-18, recorded verbatim in this ticket's comments) drove an approved three-part change set: citric-preregal-ladybird — a deletion-impact/api-compat finding naming the removed PUBLIC API `rebar.llm.review_ticket` plus a concrete broken external test scored impact 0.30, below the approved deletion-impact@0.60 / api-compat@0.51 blocking flips; brattish-ladyish-jaguar — a pass-2 recall failure on a workflow-YAML artifact. The approved set: (a1) churn/freq_mult amplify-only, never suppress, and never dampen a SERIOUS-tier binary; (a2) version-signal gating of `unversioned_published_contract_break`; (proposal-3) a pass-2 removed-public-symbol sub-question keyed on the EXPORT (not a cited caller) feeding a targeted impact boost.

STATUS OF a1: already landed on main by code-v4 (commit 61d50b0513, ticket 7f9f-05f4-796a-4c63): the debt-lane churn amplifier is [1.0,1.5] (amplify-only) and the serious-maint lane is undamped, pinned by tests/unit/test_impact_code.py (test_serious_maint_undamped_by_churn, test_debt_churn_zero_is_amplifier_one_not_half, test_freq_mult_cold_vs_hot). For a1 this ticket only corrects the stale "churn 0 => freq_mult 0.5" comment in workflow_ops.py.

## Approach
Implement a2 + proposal-3 on top of code-v4, each behavior change RED first (a test proving the current wrong score / missing gating) then GREEN:

- a2 (pass-2 classification gating): redefine `unversioned_published_contract_break` in BOTH pass-2 surfaces — the pydantic field description (verify_models.py CodeSeverityAttrs) and the code-review-verify.md prompt bullet — as TRUE only when the published-contract break LACKS a version/deprecation signal (a major version bump, a deprecation cycle, or a CHANGELOG breaking-change entry); a MANAGED removal (any such signal present) is FALSE.
- proposal-3 (pass-2 sub-question + deterministic boost): add two abstain-safe booleans to CodeSeverityAttrs — `removed_public_symbol` (TRUE when the finding cites a symbol this diff REMOVES whose name was reachable from the public API: `__all__`/re-export, a CLI command, or an MCP tool; detection keyed on the EXPORT, never on a cited caller — the absence of an internal caller does not prove an external API unused) and `version_signal_present` (TRUE when the removal carries one of the a2 signals). `decide.impact_code`'s serious-maint lane gains the derived contribution: `removed_public_symbol AND NOT version_signal_present` => the 0.9 unversioned-contract-break tier. Both fields default False, so an older/absent verifier ABSTAINS (no boost, never suppression); the boost is amplify-only — it can never lower an existing score. Bump sidecar IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION code-v4 -> code-v5 (impact semantics changed; sidecars segment by version), updating the exact-string version pins in tests.
- Eval spec: add one fire case (unmanaged removal of an exported public symbol) and one no-fire case (managed removal with a deprecation cycle + CHANGELOG breaking-change entry) to code-review-verify.eval.yaml, offline-validated by the existing spec-discipline tests.
- Interpretation note (recorded deliberately): the operator scope comment says the boost targets findings "that cite a REMOVED public symbol together with a named broken caller"; the user-approved design comment explicitly keys detection on the EXPORT, "NOT on a cited caller". The design comment wins — a named broken caller is NOT required for the boost. Assume this default unless the operator overrides it.

The pass-3 validity<0.5 hard-drop stays impact-blind, exactly as the approved design states (the brattish lever is pass-2 recall, addressed by the prompt/labeling changes above; no decider change here).

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify_models.py — a2-gated `unversioned_published_contract_break` description; 2 new CodeSeverityAttrs booleans
- src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py — impact_code serious-maint boost path (code-v5)
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-verify.md — gated bullet + removed-public-symbol sub-question guidance
- src/rebar/llm/code_review/sidecar.py — IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION "code-v5"
- src/rebar/llm/code_review/workflow_ops.py — correct the stale freq_mult-0.5 comment (a1 residue)
- src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-verify.eval.yaml — fire/no-fire removal dataset cases
- tests/unit/test_impact_code.py — boost/abstain/managed-removal tests + the citric-preregal-ladybird replay
- tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py — version pin -> code-v5
- tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py — prompt/description text pins for a2 + proposal-3

## Testing
Happy path: `impact_code({"removed_public_symbol": True}) == 0.72` (0.9 serious tier x 0.8 non-silent amp) and the citric-preregal-ladybird replay attrs (capability_degraded + reachable_path_without_automated_coverage + trigger_likelihood rare + removed_public_symbol) score >= 0.60, clearing the deletion-impact@0.60 / api-compat@0.51 flips end-to-end through the packaged routing. Failure/edge paths: a managed removal (`version_signal_present: True`) gets NO boost and scores exactly as before the change; empty attrs still score 0.0 (abstain); `version_signal_present` alone changes nothing; the boost never lowers a score that other lanes already earned. Prompt/model text pins assert the version-signal gating and the export-keyed sub-question wording on both pass-2 surfaces. Offline eval-spec validation covers the new dataset cases. Proving command: `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_impact_code.py tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py tests/unit/test_code_review_evals.py tests/unit/test_review_kernel.py`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `impact_code({"removed_public_symbol": True}) == 0.72` and the citric-preregal-ladybird replay scores >= 0.60 through the real packaged routing — checked by `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_impact_code.py`.
- [ ] A managed removal never trips the boost: the same attrs with `version_signal_present: True` score exactly the pre-change value, and empty attrs still score 0.0 — checked by `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_impact_code.py`.
- [ ] `unversioned_published_contract_break` is version-signal-gated on BOTH pass-2 surfaces (field description + prompt bullet name the major-bump / deprecation-cycle / CHANGELOG-breaking-change signals and the managed-removal=>FALSE rule) — checked by the text pins in `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py`.
- [ ] The verify prompt carries the removed-public-symbol sub-question keyed on the EXPORT (`__all__`/re-export, CLI command, MCP tool), explicitly not on a cited caller — checked by the text pins in `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_code_review_ws2.py`.
- [ ] IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION == "code-v5" and code-review-verify.eval.yaml gains one fire + one no-fire removal case that pass strict offline spec validation — checked by `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/test_impact_model_versioning.py tests/unit/test_code_review_evals.py`.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass in the worktree — checked by running them.
